title: Combat Utils
description: All-in-one PvP combat suite: anti-gank attacker limits, combat tagging, spawn protection, killstreaks, bounties, item cooldowns, and more.
body:
# ⚔️ CombatUtils

**The everything-combat plugin for Paper servers.** Stop gank squads, punish combat loggers, and give your PvP a real ruleset — all in one lightweight plugin with zero hard dependencies.

## ✨ Features

### 🛡️ Anti-Gank Attacker Limit
- Cap how many distinct players can simultaneously fight one victim
- Configurable engagement window and max-attacker count
- Blocked players get a boss bar, action bar, and chat feedback
- Protected players can't go pick fights with unrelated players while they're being ganked

### 🔥 Combat Tagging
- Live countdown boss bar while you're in combat
- Combat-log punishment: disconnect mid-fight and get killed (and publicly called out) on rejoin
- Staff alerts for combat-log events and repeated blocked-hit spam

### 🌍 Environment-Aware
- Automatically ignores creative/spectator players
- Skips Citizens NPCs
- Respects WorldGuard's PvP flag (soft-dependency, no crash if not installed)

### 🎒 Item & Weapon Restrictions
- Per-item cooldowns (ender pearls, notch apples, chorus fruit, anything you configure)
- Block specific items entirely while combat-tagged
- Per-fight use limits (e.g. 1 totem per fight) — with an upfront warning if you're carrying more than you're allowed
- Extra wind-up/reload delay for heavy weapons like the mace and trident

### 🚪 Escape Prevention
- Blocks `/home`, `/tpa`, `/warp`, `/spawn`, and any commands you configure while tagged
- Temporary spawn protection after respawning, with full chat feedback on start/end

### 🏆 Progression & Utility
- Killstreaks with server-wide milestone announcements
- Bounty system with configurable payout/charge commands (plug into any economy plugin)
- Persistent kill/death/KDR stats with a `/combatutils top` leaderboard
- Optional old-PvP (pre-1.9) mode per world
- Configurable knockback multiplier
- Autoclicker/killaura CPS flagging for staff (alerts only, no auto-punish)

## 🔧 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/combatutils status` | View current config |
| `/combatutils reload` | Reload config.yml — no restart needed |
| `/combatutils simulate <player>` | Test the attacker-limit pipeline solo |
| `/combatutils bounty set/list/clear` | Manage bounties |
| `/combatutils top` | View the kill/death leaderboard |

Aliases: `/cu`, `/combat`

## 🔑 Permissions

- `combatutils.admin` — admin commands
- `combatutils.bypass.limit` / `combatutils.exempt` — bypass the attacker limit
- `combatutils.bypass.checks` — bypass environment checks
- `combatutils.bypass.items` — bypass item/weapon restrictions
- `combatutils.bypass.commands` — bypass escape-prevention
- `combatutils.bounty` / `combatutils.stats` — player-facing features

## 📋 Requirements

- Paper 1.21.x
- Java 21+
- *(Optional)* WorldGuard — PvP-flag checks activate automatically if installed

Every feature is individually toggleable in `config.yml` — turn off what you don't need.
